articles.title: Thailand declares curfew along coast as Cambodia border fighting spreads
articles.summary: Military personnel conducted a solemn procession ceremony at a military airport, carrying the coffin of Private Mustageem Chema, draped in the Thai national flag. This event marks the transport of fallen soldiers' bodies to their hometowns, honoring their service. The ceremony underscores the nation's profound respect and remembrance for its deceased service members, highlighting the sacrifices made in defence of the nation.
